narrative: Inventory optimization for PL1__M66E6B61 completed. Demand is moderate with CV=0.55. Lead time is volatile with CV=0.89. Safety stock of 3547 units recommended for 95% service level. EOQ-based order quantity is 9069 units. The optimized policy increases annual cost by $2,096.11 compared to the previous SAP policy (safety stock=0) but provides materially improved service level protection against volatile lead times.

research_insights.selected_model: Standard EOQ with Safety Stock — continuous review (r,Q) policy
research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand CV of 0.55 (moderate) with volatile lead times (CV 0.89) makes a fixed-order-quantity system with a z-score safety buffer the most appropriate and operationally tractable choice. No trend or seasonality detected, ruling out more complex policies.
research_insights.boundary_risk: High lead time variability (CV=0.89) is the dominant risk factor. A sudden spike in lead time could temporarily deplete the safety buffer. Supplier performance monitoring is strongly recommended.
research_insights.escalation_flag: Monitor — no capacity infeasibility detected (utilization 76.4%). MOQ constraint (107 units) is non-binding given EOQ of 9,069. Regular review of lead time distribution recommended.
